result.stdout:
RepoShelf catalogs Git repositories.

Usage:
  reposhelf add <path-or-url> --reason <reason> [--group <group>] [--name <name>] [--tag <tag>]
  reposhelf list
  reposhelf show <name|id|path|url>
  reposhelf status [name|id|path|url]
  reposhelf remove <name|id|path|url>
  reposhelf where

Commands:
  add       Add or update a Git repository with a reason.
  list      List repositories on the shelf.
  show      Show details for one repository.
  status    Show git health for one repository or the whole shelf.
  remove    Remove a repository from the shelf.
  where     Print the JSON store path.

result.stdout:
Usage:
  reposhelf add <path-or-url> --reason <reason> [--group <group>] [--name <name>] [--tag <tag>]

Options:
  -r, --reason  Why this repository belongs on the shelf. Required.
  -g, --group   Group or owner name.
  -n, --name    Display name. Defaults to the repository folder name.
  -t, --tag     Tag to store with the repository. Repeatable.
